title: Round 38 (F344): Cave branch D1011/D1012 + desert maps (4/41 row-1 sand) deep-dive - layer composition, sand lib 30/40 usage, render verification (sand terrain + cave rock confirmed via inspect_image)
objective: Complete the cave/desert map survey: analyze D1011/D1012 (Bichon cave branches) and the row-1 sand maps (4.map, 41.map), verify sand library 30/40 usage and rendering, verify cave object libraries (12/13) render, and consolidate into MAP-SURVEY.md.
question: What are the layer compositions of Bichon cave branches and the desert maps? Do the sand libs (30 sand_tilesc, 40 sand_smobjectsc) and cave object libs (12 object1c, 13 object2c) render correctly?
method: Binary scan of D1011/D1012/4/41 maps (back 3-byte + cell 14-byte layers); mapviewer HTTP tile renders; inspect_image visual verification.

D1011_map.note: Bichon cave branch - uniform tiles5c floor + wood_tilesc walls + object2c decor

4_map.note: large desert - back lib 30 (sand_tilesc) used for 8817 cells; rest tilesc/tiles30c; mid/front wood_tilesc/cliffsc/smobjectsc

41_map.note: sparse desert - mostly empty (255) mid/front; back tilesc + sand_tilesc(30); mid sand_smobjectsc(40) for oasis objects

cell_analysis.sand_lib_usage: lib 30 (sand_tilesc) appears in back of both row-1 maps; lib 40 (sand_smobjectsc) in 41.map mid - row-1 binding range 28..41 includes these

render_verification.4.map: tile(1,1) -> 200, 512x512 JPEG 88658B; inspect_image: 'light tan/beige sandy brown, fine grainy texture consistent with sand'
render_verification.D1011.map: tile(1,1) -> 200, 512x512 JPEG 7751B; inspect_image: 'almost entirely black, small irregular rocky formation right edge, dark olive-green/brown/gray stone'

verdict: Bichon cave branches (D1011/D1012 300x300) use uniform tiles5c floor + wood_tilesc walls + object2c decor, render as dark rocky cave (visual verified). Desert maps (4.map 800x800 dense, 41.map 400x400 sparse) use sand_tilesc(30) back + sand_smobjectsc(40) mid within the row-1 binding range 28-41, render as sandy terrain (visual verified). MAP-SURVEY.md updated.
